## Model specification and baseline priors

The likelihood is zero-inflated negative binomial. For taxon × size class ×
habitat cell \(k\), region indicator \(B\) (0 PEV, 1 broader Broward–Miami),
survey/source \(d\), direction \(q\), and searched area \(A\):

\[
\log\mu_i=\log A_i+\alpha_{k_i}+B_i\delta^\mu_{k_i}
+u_{d_i,h_i}+v_{d_i,t_i,c_i}+w_{r_i,k_i,q_i}.
\]
\[
\operatorname{logit}(zi_i)=\zeta_{k_i}+B_i\delta^{zi}_{k_i},\qquad
\log(shape_i)=\psi_{k_i}+B_i\delta^{shape}_{k_i}.
\]

The original PEV fixed structure is `taxon:class * Type` for all three
distributional predictors. The centered count intercept prior is
`normal(-2.8, 1.8)` and count coefficients are `normal(0, 2)`; zi coefficients
are `normal(1.5, 2.5)` with `logistic(0, 1)` intercept; log-shape coefficients
are `normal(-0.9, 1)` with `student_t(3, 0, 2.5)` intercept. Source/habitat
effects retain `(1 + Type | dataset)` with `LKJ(1)` correlations, source ×
taxon × class offsets retain their shared SD, and SD priors are `exponential(4)`.
Direction SDs are specific to region.

Regional log-mean departures are `normal(0, 1.5)`; zi and log-shape departures
are independent cell deviations with separate half-normal(0, 0.75) SDs.
The source effects are shared across regions. These choices match the evaluated
full joint model. No fitted original posterior is used as a prior.

The centered, partly redundant original design is integrated to a cell-level
multivariate prior. The following calculation preserves its full covariance
and coefficient means, including the centering over the original observations.

```{r joint-model-design}
taxon_class_grid <- original_survey_counts %>% distinct(taxon, class) %>%
  arrange(taxon, class) %>% mutate(tc_id = row_number())
cell_grid <- crossing(taxon_class_grid, Type = type_levels) %>%
  arrange(tc_id, match(Type, type_levels)) %>%
  mutate(cell_id = row_number(), habitat_id = match(Type, type_levels))
design_grid <- cell_grid
for (variable in c("taxon", "class", "Type")) {
  levels_used <- if (is.factor(prediction_reference[[variable]])) {
    levels(prediction_reference[[variable]])
  } else sort(unique(prediction_reference[[variable]]))
  design_grid[[variable]] <- factor(design_grid[[variable]], levels = levels_used)
}
original_design <- model.matrix(~taxon:class * Type, data = prediction_reference)
cell_design <- model.matrix(~taxon:class * Type, data = design_grid)
stopifnot(identical(colnames(original_design), colnames(cell_design)))
centered_design <- sweep(cell_design[, -1, drop = FALSE], 2,
                         colMeans(original_design[, -1, drop = FALSE]), "-")
cell_covariance <- tcrossprod(centered_design)
eigendecomposition <- eigen(cell_covariance, symmetric = TRUE)
keep_dimensions <- eigendecomposition$values > 1e-9
fixed_prior_basis <- sweep(eigendecomposition$vectors[, keep_dimensions, drop = FALSE], 2,
                           sqrt(eigendecomposition$values[keep_dimensions]), "*")
# A covariance square root is not unique, especially with repeated eigenvalues.
# Keep a validated orientation per prior covariance so cached latent parameters
# remain interpretable; this never imports a fitted posterior as a prior.
prior_basis_key <- digest::digest(list(grid = cell_grid,
                                      covariance = signif(cell_covariance, 10)), algo = "md5")
prior_basis_file <- output_file("models", "prior_bases", paste0(prior_basis_key, ".rds"))
basis_reference <- NULL
if (file.exists(prior_basis_file)) {
  basis_reference <- readRDS(prior_basis_file)
} else if (isTRUE(params$import_completed_joint_fit)) {
  previous_input_file <- file.path(project_root, "outputs/drm_joint_full/pilot_2024/cache/prepared_inputs.rds")
  if (file.exists(previous_input_file)) {
    previous_input <- readRDS(previous_input_file)
    basis_reference <- list(grid = previous_input$grid, basis = previous_input$data$L_fixed_prior)
    rm(previous_input)
  }
}
if (!is.null(basis_reference) && identical(basis_reference$grid, cell_grid) &&
    identical(dim(basis_reference$basis), dim(fixed_prior_basis)) &&
    max(abs(tcrossprod(basis_reference$basis) - cell_covariance)) < 1e-9) {
  fixed_prior_basis <- basis_reference$basis
}
saveRDS(list(grid = cell_grid, basis = fixed_prior_basis), prior_basis_file)
count_prior_covariance <- 4 * cell_covariance + 1.8^2
stopifnot(max(abs(tcrossprod(fixed_prior_basis) - cell_covariance)) < 1e-9,
          min(eigen(count_prior_covariance, symmetric = TRUE)$values) > 0)
joint_counts <- joint_counts %>%
  left_join(select(cell_grid, taxon, class, Type, cell_id, tc_id), by = c("taxon", "class", "Type")) %>%
  mutate(region_id = match(region, c("PEV", "Broward-Miami")),
         joint_cell = cell_id + (region_id - 1L) * nrow(cell_grid),
         dataset_id = match(dataset, dataset_levels), direction_id = match(dir, c("N", "S")))
stopifnot(!anyNA(joint_counts[c("joint_cell", "dataset_id", "direction_id")]))
stan_data <- list(
  N = nrow(joint_counts), K = nrow(cell_grid), R = ncol(fixed_prior_basis),
  T = nrow(taxon_class_grid), H = 4L, D = length(dataset_levels),
  target_dataset = match("drm24", dataset_levels), y = as.integer(joint_counts$n),
  cell = as.integer(joint_counts$joint_cell), dataset = as.integer(joint_counts$dataset_id),
  direction = as.integer(joint_counts$direction_id), taxon_cell = cell_grid$tc_id,
  habitat_cell = cell_grid$habitat_id, log_area = log(joint_counts$transect_area_m2),
  L_mu_prior = t(chol(count_prior_covariance)), L_fixed_prior = fixed_prior_basis,
  fixed_prior_sums = rowSums(centered_design), region_mu_sd = 1.5,
  region_dpar_sd_scale = 0.75, grainsize = 400L
)
prepared <- list(data = stan_data, counts = joint_counts, grid = cell_grid,
                 tc = taxon_class_grid, datasets = dataset_levels,
                 original_data = prediction_reference)
saveRDS(prepared, processed_file("prepared_joint_inputs.rds"))
show_table(data.frame(original_rows = nrow(original_survey_counts),
                     added_adult_rows = nrow(regional_adults), added_juvenile_rows = nrow(regional_juveniles),
                     model_rows = nrow(joint_counts), taxon_class_cells = nrow(cell_grid)))
```

## Fit once and save the complete posterior

The Stan program is included below and is written to the new output directory
when this document runs. Its likelihood keeps every site × taxon × size-class
observation; it does not replace those observations with habitat totals.
The model uses within-chain threading and preserves all posterior draws.

```{r stan-program}
stan_code <- r"---(// Full adult and juvenile joint model; exact original PEV fixed priors.
functions {
  real joint_zinb(array[] int ys, int start, int end,
                  array[] int cell, array[] int dataset, array[] int direction,
                  vector log_area, matrix log_mu, matrix dir_effect,
                  vector zi_eta, vector phi) {
    real lp = 0;
    for (s in 1:size(ys)) {
      int i = start + s - 1;
      int k = cell[i];
      real eta = log_area[i] + log_mu[dataset[i], k]
                 + dir_effect[k, direction[i]];
      if (ys[s] == 0)
        lp += log_sum_exp(log_inv_logit(zi_eta[k]),
               log1m_inv_logit(zi_eta[k]) + neg_binomial_2_log_lpmf(0 | eta, phi[k]));
      else
        lp += log1m_inv_logit(zi_eta[k]) + neg_binomial_2_log_lpmf(ys[s] | eta, phi[k]);
    }
    return lp;
  }
}
data {
  int<lower=1> N;
  int<lower=1> K;
  int<lower=1> R;
  int<lower=1> T;
  int<lower=1> H;
  int<lower=1> D;
  int<lower=1,upper=D> target_dataset;
  array[N] int<lower=0> y;
  array[N] int<lower=1,upper=2*K> cell;
  array[N] int<lower=1,upper=D> dataset;
  array[N] int<lower=1,upper=2> direction;
  array[K] int<lower=1,upper=T> taxon_cell;
  array[K] int<lower=1,upper=H> habitat_cell;
  vector[N] log_area;
  cholesky_factor_cov[K] L_mu_prior;
  matrix[K,R] L_fixed_prior;
  vector[K] fixed_prior_sums;
  real<lower=0> region_mu_sd;
  real<lower=0> region_dpar_sd_scale;
  int<lower=1> grainsize;
}
parameters {
  vector[K] z_alpha;
  vector[K] delta_mu;
  real zi_intercept;
  vector[R] z_zi;
  real shape_intercept;
  vector[R] z_shape;
  vector[K] z_zi_region;
  vector[K] z_shape_region;
  real<lower=0> sd_zi_region;
  real<lower=0> sd_shape_region;
  matrix[H,D] dataset_raw;
  vector<lower=0>[H] sd_dataset;
  cholesky_factor_corr[H] L_dataset;
  matrix[T,D] dataset_taxon_raw;
  real<lower=0> sd_dataset_taxon;
  matrix[2*K,2] direction_raw;
  vector<lower=0>[2] sd_direction;
}
transformed parameters {
  vector[K] alpha = rep_vector(-2.8,K) + L_mu_prior * z_alpha;
  vector[2*K] zi_eta;
  vector[2*K] log_phi;
  vector[2*K] phi;
  matrix[D,H] dataset_effect = (diag_pre_multiply(sd_dataset,L_dataset) * dataset_raw)';
  matrix[D,T] dataset_taxon_effect = (sd_dataset_taxon * dataset_taxon_raw)';
  matrix[D,2*K] log_mu;
  matrix[2*K,2] dir_effect;
  zi_eta[1:K] = rep_vector(zi_intercept,K) + 1.5*fixed_prior_sums + 2.5*L_fixed_prior*z_zi;
  log_phi[1:K] = rep_vector(shape_intercept,K) - 0.9*fixed_prior_sums + L_fixed_prior*z_shape;
  zi_eta[(K+1):(2*K)] = zi_eta[1:K] + sd_zi_region*z_zi_region;
  log_phi[(K+1):(2*K)] = log_phi[1:K] + sd_shape_region*z_shape_region;
  phi = exp(log_phi);
  for (r in 1:2) for (k in 1:K) {
    int j = (r-1)*K+k;
    dir_effect[j] = sd_direction[r]*direction_raw[j];
    for (d in 1:D)
      log_mu[d,j] = alpha[k] + (r == 2 ? delta_mu[k] : 0)
        + dataset_effect[d,1]
        + (habitat_cell[k] == 1 ? 0 : dataset_effect[d,habitat_cell[k]])
        + dataset_taxon_effect[d,taxon_cell[k]];
  }
}
model {
  z_alpha ~ std_normal();
  delta_mu ~ normal(0,region_mu_sd);
  zi_intercept ~ logistic(0,1);
  z_zi ~ std_normal();
  shape_intercept ~ student_t(3,0,2.5);
  z_shape ~ std_normal();
  z_zi_region ~ std_normal();
  z_shape_region ~ std_normal();
  sd_zi_region ~ normal(0,region_dpar_sd_scale);
  sd_shape_region ~ normal(0,region_dpar_sd_scale);
  to_vector(dataset_raw) ~ std_normal();
  sd_dataset ~ exponential(4);
  L_dataset ~ lkj_corr_cholesky(1);
  to_vector(dataset_taxon_raw) ~ std_normal();
  sd_dataset_taxon ~ exponential(4);
  to_vector(direction_raw) ~ std_normal();
  sd_direction ~ exponential(4);
  target += reduce_sum_static(joint_zinb,y,grainsize,cell,dataset,direction,
                              log_area,log_mu,dir_effect,zi_eta,phi);
}
generated quantities {
  vector[2*K] density_2024;
  vector[2*K] density_north;
  vector[2*K] density_south;
  real log_lik_sum = joint_zinb(y,1,N,cell,dataset,direction,log_area,
                              log_mu,dir_effect,zi_eta,phi);
  for (j in 1:(2*K)) {
    density_2024[j] = exp(log_mu[target_dataset,j] + log1m_inv_logit(zi_eta[j]));
    density_north[j] = density_2024[j]*exp(dir_effect[j,1]);
    density_south[j] = density_2024[j]*exp(dir_effect[j,2]);
  }
})---"
```

```{r fit-settings}
fit_settings <- list(
  chains = as.integer(params$chains), warmup = as.integer(params$warmup),
  sampling = as.integer(params$sampling), threads = as.integer(params$threads_per_chain),
  adapt_delta = params$adapt_delta, max_treedepth = as.integer(params$max_treedepth),
  seed = as.integer(params$seed)
)
stopifnot(fit_settings$chains >= 2L, fit_settings$warmup > 0L, fit_settings$sampling > 0L)
stan_file <- output_file("models/joint_model.stan")
writeLines(stan_code, stan_file)
fit_signature <- list(data = stan_data, settings = fit_settings, stan = readLines(stan_file))
fit_hash <- digest::digest(fit_signature, algo = "md5")
fit_directory <- output_file("models", fit_hash)
dir.create(fit_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fit_file <- file.path(fit_directory, "posterior.rds")
saveRDS(fit_signature, file.path(fit_directory, "signature.rds"))
writeLines(stan_code, file.path(fit_directory, "model.stan"))
fit_status <- function(status) {
  jsonlite::write_json(list(status = status, fit = fit_file, hash = fit_hash,
                            settings = fit_settings, updated = as.character(Sys.time())),
                       output_file("run_status.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)
}
```

The optional import below is a cache migration, not a dependency on the earlier
experimental data-processing scripts. Rebuilding from the raw inputs remains
possible when that old directory is absent. Import requires matching cell
labels, Stan code, priors and hyperparameters, sampling settings, and all
count/effort/source/direction/region likelihood rows. Reordering identical
observations does not change the likelihood and is checked explicitly.

```{r reuse-completed-posterior}
same_likelihood <- function(first, second) {
  fields <- c("y", "cell", "dataset", "direction", "log_area")
  first_rows <- as.data.frame(first[fields])
  second_rows <- as.data.frame(second[fields])
  first_rows <- first_rows[do.call(order, first_rows), , drop = FALSE]
  second_rows <- second_rows[do.call(order, second_rows), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(first_rows) <- rownames(second_rows) <- NULL
  isTRUE(all.equal(first_rows, second_rows, tolerance = 1e-12, check.attributes = FALSE))
}
same_model_data <- function(first, second) {
  structural <- setdiff(names(first), c("y", "cell", "dataset", "direction", "log_area"))
  setequal(names(first), names(second)) && same_likelihood(first, second) &&
    all(vapply(structural, function(name) isTRUE(all.equal(first[[name]], second[[name]],
              tolerance = 1e-10, check.attributes = FALSE)), logical(1)))
}
if (!file.exists(fit_file) && isTRUE(params$import_completed_joint_fit)) {
  completed_directory <- file.path(project_root, "outputs/drm_joint_full/pilot_2024")
  completed_status <- file.path(completed_directory, "run_status.json")
  completed_inputs <- file.path(completed_directory, "cache/prepared_inputs.rds")
  if (file.exists(completed_status) && file.exists(completed_inputs)) {
    previous_status <- jsonlite::read_json(completed_status, simplifyVector = TRUE)
    candidate <- readRDS(previous_status$posterior)
    candidate_inputs <- readRDS(completed_inputs)
    candidate_stan <- file.path(dirname(previous_status$posterior), "model.stan")
    import_checks <- data.frame(
      check = c("Identical cell labels and indices", "Identical likelihood and full prior parameterization",
                "Identical sampling settings", "Identical Stan model"),
      pass = c(identical(cell_grid, candidate_inputs$grid),
               same_model_data(stan_data, candidate$data),
               identical(fit_settings, candidate$settings),
               identical(trimws(readLines(stan_file)), trimws(readLines(candidate_stan))))
    )
    write_csv(import_checks, output_file("completed_fit_import_validation.csv"))
    show_table(import_checks)
    if (all(import_checks$pass)) {
      candidate$imported_from <- list(path = previous_status$posterior, hash = candidate$hash,
                                      md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(previous_status$posterior)))
      candidate$data <- stan_data
      candidate$hash <- fit_hash
      candidate$file <- fit_file
      saveRDS(candidate, fit_file)
      message("Validated completed posterior imported to the new model cache.")
      rm(candidate)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r compiler-functions}
compatible_cpp_options <- function() {
    if (!identical(Sys.info()[["sysname"]], "Darwin")) 
        return(list())
    probe_dir <- tempfile("regional-cxx-")
    dir.create(probe_dir)
    on.exit(unlink(probe_dir, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
    source_file <- file.path(probe_dir, "check.cpp")
    executable <- file.path(probe_dir, "check")
    writeLines(c("#include <iostream>", "int main() { std::cout << \"C++ link OK\\n\"; }"), source_file)
    probe <- function(flags = character()) suppressWarnings(system2("clang++", c("-std=c++17", flags, 
        shQuote(source_file), "-o", shQuote(executable)), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE))
    default_check <- probe()
    if (is.null(attr(default_check, "status"))) 
        return(list())
    if (!any(grepl("unknown architecture", default_check, fixed = TRUE)) || !any(grepl("arm64e.x1", 
        default_check, fixed = TRUE))) 
        stop(paste(default_check, collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
    sdk <- suppressWarnings(system2("xcrun", c("--sdk", "macosx26.5", "--show-sdk-path"), stdout = TRUE, 
        stderr = TRUE))
    if (!is.null(attr(sdk, "status")) || length(sdk) != 1L || !dir.exists(sdk)) 
        stop("The compatible macOS 26.5 SDK is unavailable.", call. = FALSE)
    sdk_flags <- c("-isysroot", shQuote(normalizePath(sdk, mustWork = TRUE)))
    fallback_check <- probe(sdk_flags)
    if (!is.null(attr(fallback_check, "status"))) 
        stop(paste(fallback_check, collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
    message("Using compatible macOS SDK for this model: ", sdk)
    list(CXX = paste(c("clang++", sdk_flags), collapse = " "))
}


```

```{r fit-joint-model}
if (file.exists(fit_file)) {
  joint_fit <- readRDS(fit_file)
  stopifnot(identical(joint_fit$hash, fit_hash), same_model_data(joint_fit$data, stan_data))
  fit_status("posterior_reused")
} else {
  if (!isTRUE(params$allow_new_fit)) {
    stop("No matching completed fit. Review the import checks, or set allow_new_fit: true to sample this model.")
  }
  fit_status("compiling")
  cached_stan <- file.path(fit_directory, "model.stan")
  file.copy(stan_file, cached_stan, overwrite = TRUE)
  cpp_options <- compatible_cpp_options()
  cpp_options$stan_threads <- TRUE
  stan_model <- cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(cached_stan, cpp_options = cpp_options)
  initial_values <- lapply(seq_len(fit_settings$chains), function(chain) {
    set.seed(fit_settings$seed + chain)
    initial_rates <- joint_counts %>% filter(region == "PEV") %>% group_by(cell_id) %>%
      summarize(rate = (sum(n) + 0.1) / (sum(transect_area_m2) + 10), .groups = "drop")
    stopifnot(identical(initial_rates$cell_id, seq_len(stan_data$K)))
    # The zi/shape design has one redundant direction; solve on its full-rank basis.
    initialize_fixed <- function(target) {
      drop(qr.solve(crossprod(stan_data$L_fixed_prior),
                    crossprod(stan_data$L_fixed_prior, target)))
    }
    list(
      z_alpha = drop(solve(stan_data$L_mu_prior, log(initial_rates$rate / 0.8) + 2.8)) +
        rnorm(stan_data$K, 0, 0.02), delta_mu = rep(0, stan_data$K),
      zi_intercept = qlogis(0.2),
      z_zi = initialize_fixed(-1.5 * stan_data$fixed_prior_sums) / 2.5,
      shape_intercept = -0.9,
      z_shape = initialize_fixed(0.9 * stan_data$fixed_prior_sums),
      z_zi_region = rep(0, stan_data$K), z_shape_region = rep(0, stan_data$K),
      sd_zi_region = 0.3, sd_shape_region = 0.3,
      dataset_raw = matrix(0, stan_data$H, stan_data$D), sd_dataset = rep(0.15, stan_data$H),
      L_dataset = diag(stan_data$H), dataset_taxon_raw = matrix(0, stan_data$T, stan_data$D),
      sd_dataset_taxon = 0.15, direction_raw = matrix(0, 2 * stan_data$K, 2),
      sd_direction = c(0.15, 0.15)
    )
  })
  fit_status("sampling")
  sampled_fit <- stan_model$sample(
    data = stan_data, chains = fit_settings$chains, parallel_chains = fit_settings$chains,
    threads_per_chain = fit_settings$threads, iter_warmup = fit_settings$warmup,
    iter_sampling = fit_settings$sampling, seed = fit_settings$seed, init = initial_values,
    adapt_delta = fit_settings$adapt_delta, max_treedepth = fit_settings$max_treedepth,
    refresh = 100, output_dir = fit_directory, sig_figs = 12, save_warmup = FALSE
  )
  joint_fit <- list(draws = sampled_fit$draws(), sampler_diagnostics = sampled_fit$sampler_diagnostics(),
                    time = sampled_fit$time(), metadata = sampled_fit$metadata(),
                    settings = fit_settings, data = stan_data, hash = fit_hash, file = fit_file)
  # Save immediately, before any plotting, evaluation or report formatting.
  saveRDS(joint_fit, fit_file)
  fit_status("posterior_saved")
}
```

## Expected-density predictions

Expected density includes zero inflation: \(E[n/A]=(1-zi)\mu/A\).
PEV predictions explicitly select the PEV cells; regional predictions explicitly
select Broward–Miami cells. Both use the same joint posterior. Survey/source
effects remain included and direction effects are set to zero, matching the
original conditional prediction convention. Zero direction is not an
arithmetic average of the north and south predicted densities.

```{r predictions-functions}
expected_density_draws <- function(prepared, fit, newdata, region = "PEV") {
    draw_matrix <- if (is.matrix(fit)) 
        fit
    else posterior::as_draws_matrix(fit$draws)
    k <- match(paste(newdata$taxon, newdata$class, newdata$Type), paste(prepared$grid$taxon, prepared$grid$class, 
        prepared$grid$Type))
    d <- match(newdata$dataset, prepared$datasets)
    stopifnot(!anyNA(k), !anyNA(d))
    j <- k + (match(region, c("PEV", "Broward-Miami")) - 1L) * nrow(prepared$grid)
    vapply(seq_len(nrow(newdata)), function(i) exp(draw_matrix[, paste0("log_mu[", d[i], ",", j[i], 
        "]")] + plogis(-draw_matrix[, paste0("zi_eta[", j[i], "]")], log.p = TRUE)), numeric(nrow(draw_matrix)))
}

summarize_density_draws <- function(draw_matrix, g) cbind(g, as.data.frame(t(apply(draw_matrix, 
    2, function(x) c(mean = mean(x), median = median(x), lower = unname(quantile(x, 0.025)), upper = unname(quantile(x, 
        0.975)), maximum = max(x), largest_draw_share = max(x)/sum(x))))))


```

```{r prediction-draw-interface}
joint_epred_draws <- function(newdata, region = "PEV", ndraws = NULL) {
  prediction_matrix <- expected_density_draws(prepared, joint_fit, newdata, region)
  draw_ids <- seq_len(nrow(prediction_matrix))
  if (!is.null(ndraws) && ndraws < length(draw_ids)) {
    set.seed(params$seed)
    draw_ids <- sort(sample(draw_ids, ndraws))
    prediction_matrix <- prediction_matrix[draw_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  draws_per_row <- nrow(prediction_matrix)
  tibble(newdata[rep(seq_len(nrow(newdata)), each = draws_per_row), , drop = FALSE]) %>%
    mutate(.row = rep(seq_len(nrow(newdata)), each = draws_per_row),
           .draw = rep(draw_ids, times = nrow(newdata)),
           .epred = as.vector(prediction_matrix))
}
```

## Sampling diagnostics and posterior predictive checks

Checks retain each observation's searched area, source, region and direction.
The likelihood is independently recomputed against Stan's saved log likelihood.
PPCs check density, zero fraction, positive sites and maximum counts by
region/source/taxon/class/habitat. No posterior draws are trimmed by density.

```{r evaluation-functions}
summarize_joint_fit <- function(prepared, fit, output_dir) {
    draw_matrix <- posterior::as_draws_matrix(fit$draws)
    K <- prepared$data$K
    pars <- posterior::summarise_draws(fit$draws)
    sd <- posterior::as_draws_matrix(fit$sampler_diagnostics)
    diag <- data.frame(max_rhat = max(pars$rhat, na.rm = TRUE), min_bulk_ess = min(pars$ess_bulk, 
        na.rm = TRUE), min_tail_ess = min(pars$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE), divergences = sum(sd[, "divergent__"]), 
        treedepth_hits = sum(sd[, "treedepth__"] >= fit$settings$max_treedepth))
    diag$pass <- with(diag, max_rhat < 1.01 & min_bulk_ess > 400 & min_tail_ess > 400 & divergences == 
        0 & treedepth_hits == 0)
    write_csv(arrange(pars, desc(rhat)), file.path(output_dir, "parameter_diagnostics.csv"))
    write_csv(diag, file.path(output_dir, "sampling_diagnostics.csv"))
    print(diag)
    grid <- mutate(bind_rows(mutate(prepared$grid, region = "PEV"), mutate(prepared$grid, region = "Broward-Miami")), 
        dataset = "drm24")
    den <- cbind(expected_density_draws(prepared, draw_matrix, mutate(prepared$grid, dataset = "drm24"), 
        "PEV"), expected_density_draws(prepared, draw_matrix, mutate(prepared$grid, dataset = "drm24"), 
        "Broward-Miami"))
    sum <- left_join(summarize_density_draws(den, grid), summarise(group_by(filter(prepared$counts, 
        dataset == "drm24"), region, taxon, class, Type), rows = n(), positive_rows = sum(n > 0), 
        colonies = sum(n), searched_m2 = sum(transect_area_m2), .groups = "drop"), by = c("region", 
        "taxon", "class", "Type"))
    write_csv(sum, file.path(output_dir, "density_2024_all_cells.csv"))
    average <- function(z) vapply(seq_len(nrow(prepared$tc)), function(i) rowMeans(z[, prepared$grid$tc_id == 
        i, drop = FALSE]), numeric(nrow(z)))
    pev <- average(den[, 1:K])
    reg <- average(den[, (K + 1):(2 * K)])
    contrast <- mutate(summarize_density_draws(pev - reg, prepared$tc), probability_pev_gt_regional = colMeans(pev > 
        reg), probability_pev_lt_regional = colMeans(pev < reg))
    eligible <- prepared$tc$class == ">4cm" | prepared$tc$taxon %in% c("MCAV", "FAVI", "MEAN", "MUSS")
    contrast$regional_full_survey_support <- eligible
    for (n in c("mean", "median", "lower", "upper", "maximum", "largest_draw_share", "probability_pev_gt_regional", 
        "probability_pev_lt_regional")) contrast[[n]][!eligible] <- NA
    write_csv(contrast, file.path(output_dir, "habitat_averaged_2024_contrasts.csv"))
    z <- cbind(pev, reg, pev - reg)
    colnames(z) <- c(paste0(prepared$tc$taxon, ":", prepared$tc$class, ":PEV"), paste0(prepared$tc$taxon, 
        ":", prepared$tc$class, ":regional"), paste0(prepared$tc$taxon, ":", prepared$tc$class, 
        ":difference"))
    ar <- array(z, dim = c(dim(fit$draws)[1:2], ncol(z)), dimnames = list(NULL, NULL, colnames(z)))
    derived <- mutate(posterior::summarise_draws(posterior::as_draws_array(ar), "mean", "mcse_mean", 
        "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail"), relative_mcse = mcse_mean/pmax(abs(mean), 1e-12))
    write_csv(derived, file.path(output_dir, "prediction_diagnostics.csv"))
    set.seed(20261026)
    take <- sort(sample(seq_len(nrow(draw_matrix)), 250))
    d <- prepared$counts
    S <- length(take)
    eta <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(d)), function(i) draw_matrix[take, paste0("log_mu[", d$dataset_id[i], 
        ",", d$joint_cell[i], "]")] + draw_matrix[take, paste0("dir_effect[", d$joint_cell[i], ",", 
        d$direction_id[i], "]")] + log(d$transect_area_m2[i]), numeric(S))
    zi <- vapply(d$joint_cell, function(i) plogis(draw_matrix[take, paste0("zi_eta[", i, "]")]), 
        numeric(S))
    phi <- vapply(d$joint_cell, function(i) draw_matrix[take, paste0("phi[", i, "]")], numeric(S))
    yrep <- matrix(rnbinom(length(eta), mu = exp(eta), size = phi), S)
    yrep[matrix(runif(length(eta)), S) < zi] <- 0
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(yrep)))
    groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(d)), interaction(d$region, d$dataset, d$taxon, d$class, d$Type, 
        drop = TRUE))
    ppc <- bind_rows(lapply(groups, function(ix) {
        observed <- c(density = mean(d$n[ix]/d$transect_area_m2[ix]), zero_fraction = mean(d$n[ix] == 
            0), maximum = max(d$n[ix]), positive_sites = sum(d$n[ix] > 0))
        pred <- list(density = rowMeans(sweep(yrep[, ix, drop = FALSE], 2, d$transect_area_m2[ix], 
            "/")), zero_fraction = rowMeans(yrep[, ix, drop = FALSE] == 0), maximum = apply(yrep[, 
            ix, drop = FALSE], 1, max), positive_sites = rowSums(yrep[, ix, drop = FALSE] > 0))
        bind_rows(lapply(names(pred), function(n) {
            x <- pred[[n]]
            lo <- unname(quantile(x, 0.025))
            hi <- unname(quantile(x, 0.975))
            data.frame(d[ix[1], c("region", "dataset", "taxon", "class", "Type")], metric = n, observed = observed[[n]], 
                predicted_median = median(x), lower = lo, upper = hi, outside_95 = observed[[n]] < 
                  lo | observed[[n]] > hi)
        }))
    }))
    write_csv(ppc, file.path(output_dir, "posterior_predictive_checks.csv"))
    err <- vapply(seq_len(10), function(i) {
        lz <- log(zi[i, ])
        ln <- log1p(-zi[i, ]) + dnbinom(d$n, mu = exp(eta[i, ]), size = phi[i, ], log = TRUE)
        ix <- d$n == 0
        mx <- pmax(lz[ix], ln[ix])
        ln[ix] <- mx + log(exp(lz[ix] - mx) + exp(ln[ix] - mx))
        abs(sum(ln) - draw_matrix[take[i], "log_lik_sum"])
    }, numeric(1))
    stopifnot(max(err) < 1e-05)
    write_csv(data.frame(maximum_likelihood_recomputation_error = max(err), pass = TRUE), file.path(output_dir, 
        "likelihood_validation.csv"))
    a <- filter(ppc, dataset == "drm24", metric == "density")
    g <- ggplot(a, aes(observed, predicted_median, color = region)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, 
        color = "gray60") + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.25, width = 0) + 
        geom_point(size = 1) + facet_grid(class ~ Type, scales = "free") + theme_minimal() + labs(x = "Observed site-mean colonies/m²", 
        y = "Replicated median and 95% interval", title = "2024 posterior predictive checks")
    ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "posterior_predictive_density.png"), g, width = 12, height = 6, 
        dpi = 250, bg = "white")
    e <- list(diagnostic = diag, density = sum, contrast = contrast, derived = derived, ppc = ppc, 
        posterior_file = fit$file, hash = fit$hash)
    saveRDS(e, file.path(output_dir, "evaluation.rds"))
    e
}


```

## Final PEV density estimates

Survey-averaged outputs give equal weight to each source available in the
original taxon/class/habitat prediction grid. The 2024 outputs instead set
`dataset = "drm24"`. Habitats are given equal weight for regional comparisons;
impact-zone colony totals multiply PEV habitat densities by the **unrounded**
mapped habitat areas computed above. Adult/juvenile sums and species totals
are always calculated within posterior draws before interval summaries.
#### Datasets equal-weighted

```{r pev-survey-averaged-predictions}
# Equal weighting datasets

# Create newdata for prediction — dataset level only (site & dir not needed)
newdata <- dfftaxon %>% 
  distinct(dataset, taxon, class, Type) %>%
  mutate(transect_area_m2 = 1)

# Get predictions from the model
# - Dataset RE included
# - Direction effects set to zero on the log scale
preds <- joint_epred_draws(newdata = newdata, region = "PEV")

# Equal-weight datasets so no dataset dominates
draws_equal_weighted <- preds %>%
  group_by(.draw, taxon, class, Type) %>%
  summarize(n_m2 = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop")

# Summarize posterior draws
summary_equal_weighted_new <- draws_equal_weighted %>%
  group_by(taxon, class, Type) %>%
  mean_qi(n_m2, .width = 0.95)


draws_equal_weighted_combined <- preds %>%
  group_by(.draw, taxon, dataset, Type, class) %>%
  summarize(n_m2 = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  # Average across datasets for each class
  group_by(.draw, taxon, class, Type) %>%
  summarize(n_m2 = mean(n_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  # Compute "All" after averaging across datasets
  group_by(.draw, taxon, Type) %>%
  mutate(total_n_m2 = sum(n_m2[class != "All"])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("n_m2", "total_n_m2"),
    names_to = "class_source",
    values_to = "n_m2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(class = ifelse(class_source == "total_n_m2", "All", class)) %>%
  select(-class_source) %>%
  
  # Remove redundant "All" for single-class taxa
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  mutate(n_classes = n_distinct(class[class != "All"])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(class != "All" | n_classes > 1) %>%
  select(-n_classes)



summary_equal_weighted_combined <- draws_equal_weighted_combined %>%
  group_by(taxon, class, Type) %>%
  mean_qi(n_m2, .width = 0.95)


# Set taxon order for plotting
# Order taxa by overall abundance for plotting
taxorder <- summary_equal_weighted_combined %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  mutate(
    n_classes = n_distinct(class[class != "All"])
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter((n_classes > 1 & class == "All") | (n_classes == 1 & class != "All")) %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarize(maxdens = max(n_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(taxon = fct_reorder(taxon, -maxdens))

summary_equal_weighted_combined <- summary_equal_weighted_combined %>%
  mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = levels(taxorder$taxon)),
         class = factor(class, levels = c("<4cm", "All", ">4cm")))
```

## Densities

### Taxon densities
```{r taxon-density-figures-and-tables, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10}
##### Function to plot densities of all taxon:class:habitat combinations with provided data frame

make_taxon_density_plot <- function(densities, output_path, width, height) {
  
  # Create base plot
  taxdens <- ggplot(densities, aes(x = Type, y = n_m2, color = class)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper), width = 0, linewidth = 0.4,
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.2), alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(group = class), position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
    facet_wrap(~taxon, labeller = labeller(taxon = as_labeller(taxon_labels, label_parsed)),
               scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = type_labels) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("<4cm" = "#d95f02", ">4cm" = "#1b9e77", "All" = "#7570b3"),
      labels = c("<4cm", "≥4cm", "All"),
      breaks = c("<4cm", ">4cm", "All")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Habitat Type",
      y = bquote("Density (colonies m"^-2*")"),
      color = "Size class"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Generate taxon group annotations
  taxon_group_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(taxon_groups_juv), function(group) {
    tibble(taxon = taxon_groups_juv[[group]], group = group)
  })) %>%
    filter(taxon != group)
  
  annotation_df <- densities %>%
    distinct(taxon) %>%
    left_join(taxon_group_df, by = "taxon") %>%
    filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
    mutate(
      group2 = case_when(
        group == "FAVI" ~ "Faviinae",
        group == "MUSS" ~ "Mussinae",
        group == "MEAN" ~ "Meandrinidae",
        TRUE ~ group
      ),
      taxon = factor(taxon, levels = taxorder$taxon),
      label = paste0("<4cm = ", group2),
      x = 2.5,
      y = Inf
    )
  
  # Final figure with annotations
  fig <- taxdens +
    geom_text(data = annotation_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0.5, size = 2.5, color = "#d95f02") +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.width = unit(2, "lines"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA))
  
  # Save and return the plot
  save_figure(filename = output_path, plot = fig, 
         width = width, height = height, 
         units = "mm", dpi = 300)
  return(fig)
}

#### TABLE version

make_taxon_density_table <- function(densities, output_path) {
  
  # Set display order
  type_order <- unique(densities$Type)  # preserves appearance order
  class_order <- c("<4cm", ">4cm", "All")
  taxon_levels <- taxorder$taxon  # assumed available
  
  # Format and reshape
  table_out <- densities %>%
    mutate(
      taxon = factor(taxon, levels = taxon_levels),
      class = factor(class, levels = class_order),
      Type = factor(Type, levels = type_order),
      mean_ci = sprintf(
        "%s [%s–%s]",  # en-dash
        formatC(n_m2, format = "fg", digits = 2, flag = "#"),
        formatC(.lower, format = "fg", digits = 2, flag = "#"),
        formatC(.upper, format = "fg", digits = 2, flag = "#")
      )
    ) %>%
    select(taxon, class, Type, mean_ci) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Type, values_from = mean_ci) %>%
    arrange(taxon, class)
  
  # Save to CSV
  write_csv(table_out, file = output_path)
  
  return(table_out)
}
```

```{r raw-versus-modeled-figure-a1}
# Average density per dataset-taxon-class-Type group
raw_density_summary <- pev_raw_counts %>%
  mutate(density = n / transect_area_m2) %>%
  group_by(dataset, taxon, class, Type) %>%
  summarize(
    raw_density_mean = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    raw_density_sd   = sd(density, na.rm = TRUE),
    raw_density_n    = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    raw_density_se = raw_density_sd / sqrt(raw_density_n),
    t_crit = qt(0.975, df = raw_density_n - 1),
    raw_density_lower = pmax(0, raw_density_mean - t_crit * raw_density_se),
    raw_density_upper = raw_density_mean + t_crit * raw_density_se
  )
```

### Total densities by size and SCTLD-susceptibility

```{r total-density-figures}
make_combined_density_figure <- function(draws, table = FALSE,
                                         output_path,
                                         y_limits = c(0, 2.8)) {
  draws <- draws %>% filter(class != "All")
  type_order <- unique(draws$Type)
  y_breaks <- seq(y_limits[1], y_limits[2] - 0.3, 0.5)
  y_minor_breaks <- seq(y_limits[1], y_limits[2] - 0.05, 0.25)
  
  # -- Total density summary --
  summary_total <- draws %>%
    group_by(.draw, Type) %>%
    summarize(total_density = sum(n_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Type) %>%
    summarize(
      mean = mean(total_density),
      lower = quantile(total_density, 0.025),
      upper = quantile(total_density, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  plot_total <- ggplot(summary_total, aes(x = Type, y = mean)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#7570b3") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = type_labels2) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits,
      breaks = y_breaks,
      minor_breaks = y_minor_breaks,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Habitat Type",
      y = bquote("Density (colonies m"^-2*")")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  # -- Size class summary --
  summary_class <- draws %>%
    group_by(.draw, Type, class) %>%
    summarize(total_epred = sum(n_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Type, class) %>%
    mean_qi(total_epred, .width = 0.95) %>%
    mutate(
      class = factor(class, levels = c("<4cm", ">4cm")),
      label = sprintf("%.2f", total_epred)
    )
  
  plot_class <- ggplot(summary_class, aes(x = Type, y = total_epred, fill = class)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(">4cm" = "#1b9e77", "<4cm" = "#d95f02")) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = type_labels2) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits,
      breaks = y_breaks,
      minor_breaks = y_minor_breaks,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Habitat Type",
      y = "",
      fill = "Size Class"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.key.size = unit(4, "mm"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
      legend.position = c(0.75, 0.85),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  # -- SCTLD susceptibility summary --
  summary_sus <- draws %>%
    left_join(group_definitions, by = "taxon") %>%
    group_by(.draw, Type, sus_group) %>%
    summarize(total_epred = sum(n_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Type, sus_group) %>%
    mean_qi(total_epred, .width = 0.95) %>%
    mutate(
      taxon_group = factor(sus_group, levels = c("high_sus", "mod_sus", "low_sus")),
      label = sprintf("%.2f", total_epred)
    )
  
  plot_sus <- ggplot(summary_sus, aes(x = Type, y = total_epred, fill = sus_group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "high_sus" = darken("#7570b3", 0.5),
        "mod_sus"  = "#7570b3",
        "low_sus"  = lighten("#7570b3", 0.5)
      ),
      labels = c(
        "high_sus" = "High",
        "mod_sus"  = "Moderate",
        "low_sus"  = "Low"
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = type_labels2) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits,
      breaks = y_breaks,
      minor_breaks = y_minor_breaks,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Habitat Type",
      y = "",
      fill = "SCTLD\nSusceptibility"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.key.size = unit(4, "mm"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
      legend.position = c(0.75, 0.85),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
  
  # -- Combine all panels --
  combined_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    plot_total, plot_class, plot_sus,
    ncol = 3,
    labels = c("A", "B", "C"),
    label_size = 10,
    align = "hv"
  )
  
  if (table == FALSE) {
    save_figure(filename = output_path, plot = combined_plot, width = 180, height = 80, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
    return(combined_plot)
  } else {
    return(list(summary_sus, summary_class, summary_total))
  }
}
```

## Temporal trends

```{r temporal-trend-estimates}
# Prediction grid
newdata <- dfftaxon %>%     
  distinct(dataset, Type, taxon, class) %>%
  mutate(transect_area_m2 = 1) %>%
  #### Add missing habitat Type (Outer Reef) for drm24 dataset (will be imputed)
  group_by(dataset, taxon, class) %>%
  complete(Type = unique(dfftaxon$Type),  # add all habitat Types
           fill = list(transect_area_m2 = 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Predictions (same as before)
preds <- joint_epred_draws(newdata = newdata, region = "PEV", ndraws = 2000)

# Average across habitat types per draw
preds_avg <- preds %>%
  group_by(.draw, dataset, taxon, class) %>%
  summarize(mean_epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(year = parse_number(as.character(dataset)))

# Helper function for slopes + modeled changes
compute_trends <- function(data, group_vars, value_col) {
  data %>%
    filter(year >= 17) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars)), .draw) %>%
    summarise(
      fit = list(lm(reformulate("year", value_col))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      intercept  = map_dbl(fit, ~ coef(.x)[1]),
      slope      = map_dbl(fit, ~ coef(.x)[2]),
      pred_17    = intercept + slope * 17,
      pred_24    = intercept + slope * 24,
      abs_change = pred_24 - pred_17,
      pct_change = ifelse(pred_17 > 0, (pred_24 - pred_17) / pred_17 * 100, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    select(-fit)
}

# Taxon × class
trends_taxon_class <- compute_trends(preds_avg, c("taxon", "class"), "mean_epred")

trends_taxon_class_preds <- trends_taxon_class %>%
  crossing(year = 17:24) %>%                     # add year range
  mutate(pred_density = intercept + slope * year) %>%
  group_by(taxon, class, year) %>%
  mean_qi(pred_density, .width = 0.95) 

# Taxon totals
trends_taxon <- preds_avg %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(class) > 1) %>%   # keep only taxa with multiple size classes
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(.draw, dataset, taxon, year) %>%
  summarise(total_epred = sum(mean_epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  compute_trends(c("taxon"), "total_epred") %>%
  mutate(class = "All")

trends_taxon_preds <- trends_taxon %>%
  crossing(year = 17:24) %>%                     # add year range
  mutate(pred_density = intercept + slope * year) %>%
  group_by(taxon, year) %>%
  mean_qi(pred_density, .width = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(class = "All")

# All corals (overall)
trends_all_totals <- preds_avg %>%
  # Totals cannot be derived from the ESA-only surveys
  filter(dataset %in% c("dca17", "tt21", "tt23", "drm24")) %>%
  group_by(.draw, dataset, year) %>%
  summarise(total_epred = sum(mean_epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  compute_trends(character(0), "total_epred") %>%
  mutate(taxon = "All", class = "All")

# All corals by size class
trends_all_by_class <- preds_avg %>%
  # Totals cannot be derived from the ESA-only surveys
  filter(dataset %in% c("dca17", "tt21", "tt23", "drm24")) %>%
  group_by(.draw, dataset, year, class) %>%
  summarise(total_epred = sum(mean_epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  compute_trends("class", "total_epred") %>%
  mutate(taxon = "All")

# Combine
trends_all <- bind_rows(trends_all_totals, trends_all_by_class)

trends_all_preds <- trends_all %>%
  crossing(year = 17:24) %>%                     # add year range
  mutate(pred_density = intercept + slope * year) %>%
  group_by(class, year) %>%
  mean_qi(pred_density, .width = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(taxon = "All")

# Combine results
trends_combined <- bind_rows(
  trends_taxon_class %>% mutate(level = "taxon_class"),
  trends_taxon %>% mutate(level = "taxon"),
  trends_all %>% mutate(level = "all")
)

preds_combined <- bind_rows(
  trends_taxon_class_preds %>% mutate(level = "taxon_class"),
  trends_taxon_preds %>% mutate(level = "taxon"),
  trends_all_preds %>% mutate(level = "all")
)

# Summarize posterior distributions
trends_summary <- trends_combined %>%
  group_by(level, taxon, class) %>%
  mean_qi(slope, abs_change, pct_change, .width = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble()

# Derive the previously interactive ordering object explicitly.
trends_summary_subset <- trends_summary %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  filter(if (any(class == "All")) class == "All" else TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>% mutate(taxon = fct_reorder(taxon, -abs(abs_change)))

# Identify temporal changes whose pointwise interval excludes zero
preds_combined <- preds_combined %>%
  left_join(
    trends_summary %>%
      mutate(sig_trend = sign(slope.lower) == sign(slope.upper)) %>%
      select(taxon, class, sig_trend),
    by = c("taxon", "class")
  )

preds_combined <- preds_combined %>%
  mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = levels(trends_summary_subset$taxon)))

trends_summary <- trends_summary %>%
  mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = levels(trends_summary_subset$taxon)))


# Taxon × class summary
summary_taxon_class <- preds_avg %>%
  group_by(dataset, taxon, class) %>%
  mean_qi(mean_epred, .width = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(level = "taxon_class")

# Taxon totals (sum over classes)
summary_taxon <- preds_avg %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(class) > 1) %>%   # keep only taxa with multiple size classes
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(.draw, dataset, taxon) %>%
  summarise(mean_epred = sum(mean_epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(dataset, taxon) %>%
  mean_qi(mean_epred, .width = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(class = "All", level = "taxon")

# All corals combined (sum over taxa and classes)
summary_all <- preds_avg %>%
  # Totals cannot be derived from the ESA-only surveys
  filter(dataset %in% c("dca17", "tt21", "tt23", "drm24")) %>%
  group_by(.draw, dataset) %>%
  summarise(mean_epred = sum(mean_epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  mean_qi(mean_epred, .width = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(taxon = "All", class = "All", level = "all")

# All corals combined by size class (sum over taxa)
summary_all_by_class <- preds_avg %>%
  # Totals cannot be derived from the ESA-only surveys
  filter(dataset %in% c("dca17", "tt21", "tt23", "drm24")) %>%
  group_by(.draw, dataset, class) %>%
  summarise(mean_epred = sum(mean_epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(dataset, class) %>%
  mean_qi(mean_epred, .width = 0.95) %>%
  mutate(taxon = "All", level = "all_by_class")

# Combine all summaries
summary_datasets <- bind_rows(
  summary_taxon_class,
  summary_taxon,
  summary_all,
  summary_all_by_class
) %>%
  mutate(year = parse_number(dataset)) %>%
  mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = levels(trends_summary_subset$taxon)))


trends_summary <- trends_summary %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  mutate(
    y_max = max(summary_datasets$.upper[summary_datasets$taxon == unique(taxon)], na.rm = TRUE),
    n_classes = n_distinct(class),
    y_label = case_when(
      n_classes == 1 ~ y_max * 1.02,  # single class at top
      n_classes == 2 & class %in% c("All", ">4cm") ~ y_max * 1.02,  # top position for first
      n_classes == 2 & class == "<4cm" ~ y_max * 0.87,              # middle position for second
      n_classes == 3 & class == "All" ~ y_max * 1.02,
      n_classes == 3 & class == ">4cm" ~ y_max * 0.87,
      n_classes == 3 & class == "<4cm" ~ y_max * 0.72,
      TRUE ~ y_max * 1.02  # fallback
    ),
    sig_trend = sign(slope.lower) == sign(slope.upper),
    abs_change
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r temporal-trajectories-figure4}
# Final Figure 5 trends plot

alltax <- ggplot(summary_datasets %>% filter(taxon == "All"), aes(x = year, y = mean_epred)) +

                        paste0("+", signif(abs_change, 2)),

  facet_wrap(~taxon, scales = "free",

  labs(y = expression("Colonies m"^-2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +

                       str_pad("2017", width = 4, side = "right"),
                       str_pad("2021", width = 4, side = "right"),
                       str_pad("2023", width = 7, side = "right"),
                       str_pad("2024", width = 4, side = "left")))+
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),

        axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = -1)),
```

### Plot abs. changes
```{r temporal-changes-figure5}
# Final figure 6 trends plot

# Custom signed log-like transform
signed_pseudo_log <- function(x, scale = 1000) {
  sign(x) * log1p(abs(x) * scale)
}

# Transform slopes
scale_factor <- 2000
trends_summary_trans <- trends_summary %>%
  mutate(
    abs_change_trans = signed_pseudo_log(abs_change, scale = scale_factor),
    lower_trans = signed_pseudo_log(abs_change.lower, scale = scale_factor),
    upper_trans = signed_pseudo_log(abs_change.upper, scale = scale_factor),
    taxon = fct_reorder(taxon, abs_change)
  )

# Tick marks (original scale)
ticks <- c(-1, -0.5, -0.2, -0.1, -0.05, -0.02, -0.01, -0.005, -0.002, -0.001,
            -0.0005, -0.0001, 0.0001, 0.0005,
            0.001, 0.002, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1)
# Custom function to format tick labels
format_ticks <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(v) {
    if (v == 0) {
      "0"
    } else {
      sub("\\.?0+$", "", format(v, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))
    }
  })
}

xmax <- max(trends_summary_trans$upper_trans)
xmin <- min(trends_summary_trans$lower_trans)

# Plot
ggplot(trends_summary_trans, aes(x = abs_change_trans, y = taxon)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = class, size = class), position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
             alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(color = class, xmin = lower_trans, xmax = upper_trans), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), height = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = signed_pseudo_log(ticks, scale = scale_factor),      # positions in transformed space
    minor_breaks = NULL, 
    labels = format_ticks(ticks),       # labels in original space
    limits = c(xmin, xmax),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = function(x) parse(text = taxon_labels[x])  # now safe with proper levels
  )  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("<4cm" = "#d95f02", ">4cm" = "#1b9e77", "All" = "#7570b3"))+
  scale_size_manual(values = c(1,3,5)) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Change in density (colonies m"^{-2}*") 2017–2024"),
    y = "",
    color = "Size class",
    size = "Size class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.position = c(0.86, 0.22),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linewidth = 0.2),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),    # vertical space between items
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm"))    # horizontal space between items)

save_figure(filename = output_file("Fig5.png"), width = 140, height = 120, units = "mm", dpi = 300)
```

## Totals in impact zones

### Equal-weighted estimates
```{r survey-averaged-impact-tables}
format_count <- function(x) {
  format(round(x), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
}

format_interval_count <- function(estimate, lower, upper) {
  paste0(
    format_count(estimate),
    " (",
    format_count(lower),
    "-",
    format_count(upper),
    ")"
  )
}

make_taxclass_zone_interval_table <- function(draw_totals) {
  draw_totals <- draw_totals %>%
    mutate(
      taxon = as.character(taxon),
      class = as.character(class),
      name = as.character(name)
    )

  draw_totals_for_table <- bind_rows(
    draw_totals,
    draw_totals %>%
      group_by(.draw, taxon, class) %>%
      summarize(name = "Total", tot = sum(tot), .groups = "drop"),
    draw_totals %>%
      group_by(.draw, name) %>%
      summarize(taxon = "Total", class = "-", tot = sum(tot), .groups = "drop"),
    draw_totals %>%
      group_by(.draw) %>%
      summarize(taxon = "Total", class = "-", name = "Total", tot = sum(tot), .groups = "drop")
  )

  draw_totals_for_table %>%
    mutate(
      name = factor(name, levels = c(zone_levels, "Total")),
      taxon = factor(taxon, levels = c(sort(unique(draw_totals$taxon)), "Total")),
      class = factor(class, levels = c("<4cm", ">4cm", "-"))
    ) %>%
    group_by(taxon, class, name) %>%
    summarize(
      tot_estimate = mean(tot),
      tot_lower_95 = quantile(tot, 0.025),
      tot_upper_95 = quantile(tot, 0.975),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(tot = format_interval_count(tot_estimate, tot_lower_95, tot_upper_95)) %>%
    arrange(taxon, class, name) %>%
    select(taxon, class, name, tot) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = tot, names_sort = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      taxon = as.character(taxon),
      class = as.character(class)
    )
}

# TOTAL COLONIES IN EACH IMPACT ZONE
densities_tot_draws <- draws_equal_weighted_combined %>% filter(class != "All")

# Calculate total per taxclass per habitat Type and impact zone
tot1_draws <- left_join(densities_tot_draws, area_summary, by = "Type") %>%
  mutate(tot = n_m2 * total_area_m2)

# Calculate total per taxclass per impact zone (sum all habitat Types)
tot2_draws <- tot1_draws %>%
  group_by(.draw, taxon, class, name) %>%
  summarize(tot = sum(tot), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(name)

tot2 <- tot2_draws %>%
  group_by(taxon, class, name) %>%
  mean_qi(tot, .width = 0.95) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(tot = round(tot))

tab2 <- make_taxclass_zone_interval_table(tot2_draws)

tab2 %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Total number of colonies in each impact zone - surveys (years) equal-weighted")

write_csv(tab2, file = output_file("TableA4.csv"))


# Calculate total ESA and non-ESA corals per impact zone
tot3_draws <- tot2_draws %>%
  mutate(ESA = case_when(!taxon %in% c("ACER", "ORBI") ~ "non-ESA",
                         TRUE ~ taxon)) %>%
  group_by(.draw, name, ESA) %>%
  summarize(tot = sum(tot), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ESA, values_from = tot, values_fill = list(tot = 0)) %>%
  mutate(Total = ACER + ORBI + `non-ESA`)

tot3 <- tot3_draws %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarize(
    ACER = round(mean(ACER)),
    ORBI = round(mean(ORBI)),
    `non-ESA` = round(mean(`non-ESA`)),
    Total = round(mean(Total)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(cum_ACER = cumsum(ACER),
         cum_ORBI = cumsum(ORBI),
         cum_non_ESA = cumsum(`non-ESA`),
         cum_Total = cumsum(Total)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ format(round(.), big.mark = ","))) 

tot3 %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Total coral colonies in all impact zones")

dir.create(output_file("intermediate"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(tot3, file = output_file("intermediate/coral_Table2.csv"))

tot3_total_draws <- tot3_draws %>%
  group_by(.draw) %>%
  summarize(
    name = "Total",
    ACER = sum(ACER),
    ORBI = sum(ORBI),
    `non-ESA` = sum(`non-ESA`),
    Total = sum(Total),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

tot3_intervals <- bind_rows(tot3_draws, tot3_total_draws) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c(zone_levels, "Total"))) %>%
  arrange(name) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarize(
    ACER_estimate = mean(ACER),
    ACER_lower_95 = quantile(ACER, 0.025),
    ACER_upper_95 = quantile(ACER, 0.975),
    ORBI_estimate = mean(ORBI),
    ORBI_lower_95 = quantile(ORBI, 0.025),
    ORBI_upper_95 = quantile(ORBI, 0.975),
    non_ESA_estimate = mean(`non-ESA`),
    `non-ESA_lower_95` = quantile(`non-ESA`, 0.025),
    `non-ESA_upper_95` = quantile(`non-ESA`, 0.975),
    Total_estimate = mean(Total),
    Total_lower_95 = quantile(Total, 0.025),
    Total_upper_95 = quantile(Total, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    ACER = ACER_estimate,
    ORBI = ORBI_estimate,
    `non-ESA` = non_ESA_estimate,
    Total = Total_estimate
  ) %>%
  select(
    name,
    ACER, ACER_lower_95, ACER_upper_95,
    ORBI, ORBI_lower_95, ORBI_upper_95,
    `non-ESA`, `non-ESA_lower_95`, `non-ESA_upper_95`,
    Total, Total_lower_95, Total_upper_95
  ) %>%
  mutate(name = as.character(name))

tot3_intervals %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Total coral colonies in all impact zones with 95% posterior intervals")

write_csv(tot3_intervals, file = output_file("intermediate/coral_Table2_intervals.csv"))
```

#### Treemap plot - Scenario2+NMFS
```{r working_treemap1}
# Aggregate total abundance by taxon + class
tot4 <- tot2 %>%
  filter(name != "Rest of Monitoring Area") %>%
  group_by(taxon, class) %>%
  summarize(tot = sum(tot), .groups = "drop")

# Assign a base color per taxon
set.seed(3)
base_colors <- sample(ggsci::pal_d3("category20")(20), 20)
names(base_colors) <- taxon_palette_order

# Define shading function
get_shades <- function(base_col, class, all_classes) {
  if (length(all_classes) == 2) {
    if (class == "<4cm") colorspace::lighten(base_col, 0.1)
    else colorspace::darken(base_col, 0.1)
  } else {
    base_col
  }
}

# Build taxon_class and corresponding shades
shade_map <- tot4 %>%
  distinct(taxon, class) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    base_col = base_colors[[taxon]],
    all_classes = list(tot4$class[tot4$taxon == taxon]),
    shade = get_shades(base_col, class, all_classes),
    taxon_class = paste(taxon, class, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Final color map
fill_colors <- setNames(shade_map$shade, shade_map$taxon_class)

# Add taxon_class to original data
tot4 <- tot4 %>%
  mutate(taxon_class = paste(taxon, class, sep = "_"))

# Plot with taxon labels only
p <- ggplot(tot4, aes(area = tot, fill = taxon_class, subgroup = taxon)) +
  geom_treemap(color = NA)+#, layout = "srow") +
  geom_treemap_subgroup_border(colour = "white", size = 1)+#, layout = "srow") +
  # geom_treemap_subgroup_text(place = "topleft", grow = TRUE, 
  #                             alpha = 0.8, colour = "black", size = 8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# Get tile layout and attach taxon_class
tile_layout <- treemapify(tot4, area = "tot",#, layout = "srow",
                          fill = "taxon_class", subgroup = "taxon")

# Flag small boxes (aggregate size classes)
tile_layout_ag <- tile_layout %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarize(xmin = min(xmin), xmax = max(xmax),
            ymin = min(ymin), ymax = max(ymax),
            area = (xmax - xmin) * (ymax - ymin),
            center_x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
            center_y = (ymin + ymax) / 2)
area_threshold <- 0.001
internal_labels <- tile_layout_ag %>% 
  filter(area >= area_threshold)
external_labels <- tile_layout_ag %>% 
  filter(area < area_threshold)

# Create labels with taxontotals
taxtots <- tot4 %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarize(tot = scales::comma(sum(tot)))

internal_labels <- left_join(internal_labels, taxtots) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(taxon, "\n", tot))

external_labels <- left_join(external_labels, taxtots) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(taxon, "\n", tot))

# Final plot
p + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  geom_text(data = internal_labels,
            aes(x = xmin, y = ymax-0.00001,
                label = label, size = area), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, lineheight = 0.7,
            nudge_x = 0.001, nudge_y = -0.005) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 15)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = external_labels,
             aes(x = center_x, y = center_y, 
                 label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             max.overlaps = Inf,
             box.padding = 0.18,
             xlim = c(1, NA),
             force = 3,
             lineheight = 0.7,
             min.segment.length = 0.1,
             segment.size = 0.2,
             hjust = 0,
             size = 1.7, seed = 123) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  ) +
  labs(title = "Total corals in scenario 2 zones + NMFS areas, surveys (all years) equal-weighted")
  
save_figure(filename = output_file("Fig6.png"), width = 180, height = 130, units = "mm", dpi = 600)
```

```{r working_treemap2}
  # geom_treemap_subgroup_text(place = "topleft", grow = TRUE, 
  #                             alpha = 0.8, colour = "black", size = 8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# Get tile layout and attach taxon_class
tile_layout <- treemapify(tot4, area = "tot", 
                          fill = "taxon_class", subgroup = "taxon")

# Flag small boxes (aggregate size classes)
tile_layout_ag <- tile_layout %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarize(xmin = min(xmin), xmax = max(xmax),
            ymin = min(ymin), ymax = max(ymax),
            area = (xmax - xmin) * (ymax - ymin),
            center_x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
            center_y = (ymin + ymax) / 2)
area_threshold <- 0.001
internal_labels <- tile_layout_ag %>% 
  filter(area >= area_threshold)
external_labels <- tile_layout_ag %>% 
  filter(area < area_threshold)

# Create labels with taxontotals
taxtots <- tot4 %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarize(tot = scales::comma(sum(tot)))

internal_labels <- left_join(internal_labels, taxtots) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(taxon, "\n", tot))

external_labels <- left_join(external_labels, taxtots) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(taxon, "\n", tot))

# Final plot
p + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  geom_text(data = internal_labels,
            aes(x = xmin, y = ymax-0.00001,
                label = label, size = area), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, lineheight = 0.7,
            nudge_x = 0.005, nudge_y = -0.005) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 15)) +
  geom_text_repel(data = external_labels,
             aes(x = center_x, y = center_y, 
                 label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             max.overlaps = Inf,
             xlim = c(1, NA),
             force = 5,
             min.segment.length = 0.1,
             segment.size = 0.2,
             hjust = 0, seed = 123,
             size = 2) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  ) +
  labs(title = "Total corals in full impact monitoring area, surveys (all years) equal-weighted")
  
save_figure(filename = output_file("FigA4.png"), width = 180, height = 130, units = "mm", dpi = 600)
```

```{r 2024-impact-tables}
# TOTAL COLONIES IN EACH IMPACT ZONE
densities_tot_2024_draws <- draws_drm24_combined %>% filter(class != "All")


# Calculate total per taxclass per habitat Type and impact zone
tot1_2024_draws <- left_join(densities_tot_2024_draws, area_summary, by = "Type") %>%
  mutate(tot = n_m2 * total_area_m2)

# Calculate total per taxclass per impact zone (sum all habitat Types)
tot2_2024_draws <- tot1_2024_draws %>%
  group_by(.draw, taxon, class, name) %>%
  summarize(tot = sum(tot), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(name)

tot2_2024 <- tot2_2024_draws %>%
  group_by(taxon, class, name) %>%
  mean_qi(tot, .width = 0.95) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(tot = round(tot))

tab2_2024 <- make_taxclass_zone_interval_table(tot2_2024_draws)

tab2_2024 %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Total number of colonies in each impact zone - 2024 estimates")

write_csv(tab2_2024, file = output_file("TableA5.csv"))


## SUM ESA and non-ESA corals
# Calculate total ESA and non-ESA corals per impact zone
tot3_2024_draws <- tot2_2024_draws %>%
  mutate(ESA = case_when(!taxon %in% c("ACER", "ORBI") ~ "non-ESA",
                         TRUE ~ taxon)) %>%
  group_by(.draw, name, ESA) %>%
  summarize(tot = sum(tot), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ESA, values_from = tot, values_fill = list(tot = 0)) %>%
  mutate(Total = ACER + ORBI + `non-ESA`) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = zone_levels)) %>%
  arrange(.draw, name) %>%
  group_by(.draw) %>%
  mutate(cum_ACER = cumsum(ACER),
         cum_ORBI = cumsum(ORBI),
         cum_non_ESA = cumsum(`non-ESA`),
         cum_Total = cumsum(Total)) %>%
  ungroup()

tot3_2024 <- tot3_2024_draws %>%
  select(.draw, name, ACER, ORBI, `non-ESA`, Total, cum_ACER, cum_ORBI, cum_non_ESA, cum_Total) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(.draw, name), names_to = "metric", values_to = "tot") %>%
  group_by(name, metric) %>%
  summarize(
    tot_estimate = mean(tot),
    tot_lower_95 = quantile(tot, 0.025),
    tot_upper_95 = quantile(tot, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    name = factor(name, levels = zone_levels),
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("ACER", "ORBI", "non-ESA", "Total", "cum_ACER", "cum_ORBI", "cum_non_ESA", "cum_Total")),
    tot = format_interval_count(tot_estimate, tot_lower_95, tot_upper_95)
  ) %>%
  arrange(name, metric) %>%
  select(name, metric, tot) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = tot) %>%
  mutate(name = as.character(name))

tot3_2024 %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Total coral colonies in all impact zones, 2024 estimates")

write_csv(tot3_2024, file = output_file("TableA6.csv"))
```
