# 2024 PEV versus the rest of Broward–Miami

The following comparisons use paired predictions from this one joint model,
with `dataset = "drm24"`, area 1 m², and direction effects set to zero. Each
habitat receives weight 1/4 in each region. The first four Table A3 density
columns remain PEV-specific; the regional columns compare the same target year
and habitat weighting. Species sums and adult-plus-juvenile sums retain their
within-draw covariance.

```{r regional-comparison-functions}
make_regional_table <- function(prepared, fit, output_dir) {
    habitats <- c("Nearshore Ridge Complex", "Inner Reef", "Middle Reef", "Outer Reef")
    juvenile_groups <- c("MCAV", "MEAN", "MUSS", "FAVI")
    nd <- mutate(prepared$grid, dataset = "drm24")
    draw_matrix <- posterior::as_draws_matrix(fit$draws)
    pev <- expected_density_draws(prepared, draw_matrix, nd, "PEV")
    regional <- expected_density_draws(prepared, draw_matrix, nd, "Broward-Miami")
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(pev)), all(is.finite(regional)), all(table(paste(nd$taxon, nd$class)) == 
        length(habitats)), prepared$datasets[prepared$data$target_dataset] == "drm24")
    stan_density <- draw_matrix[, paste0("density_2024[", seq_len(2 * nrow(nd)), "]"), drop = FALSE]
    stan_error <- max(abs(cbind(pev, regional) - stan_density)/pmax(1, abs(stan_density)))
    tc <- mutate(distinct(prepared$grid, taxon, class), row_type = "Taxon")
    combined <- transmute(filter(count(tc, taxon), n > 1), taxon, class = "All", row_type = "Taxon")
    rows <- arrange(bind_rows(tc, combined), taxon, match(class, c("<4cm", ">4cm", "All")))
    rows <- bind_rows(rows, data.frame(taxon = "Total modeled taxa", class = c("<4cm", ">4cm", "All"), 
        row_type = "Total"), data.frame(taxon = "Surveyed juvenile groups (4)", class = "<4cm", 
        row_type = "Surveyed juvenile subtotal"))
    rows$row_id <- seq_len(nrow(rows))
    members <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) {
        x <- rows[i, ]
        if (x$row_type == "Taxon") 
            which(prepared$tc$taxon == x$taxon & (x$class == "All" | prepared$tc$class == x$class))
        else if (x$row_type == "Total") 
            which(x$class == "All" | prepared$tc$class == x$class)
        else which(prepared$tc$class == "<4cm" & prepared$tc$taxon %in% juvenile_groups)
    })
    supported_tc <- prepared$tc$class == ">4cm" | prepared$tc$taxon %in% juvenile_groups
    rows$regional_full_survey_support <- vapply(members, function(ix) all(supported_tc[ix]), logical(1))
    rows$component_count <- lengths(members)
    rows$component_taxa <- vapply(members, function(ix) paste(prepared$tc$taxon[ix], collapse = " + "), 
        character(1))
    cell_grid <- mutate(rows[rep(seq_len(nrow(rows)), each = length(habitats)), ], Type = rep(habitats, 
        nrow(rows)))
    sum_cells <- function(z) vapply(seq_len(nrow(cell_grid)), function(i) {
        ids <- prepared$tc$tc_id[members[[cell_grid$row_id[i]]]]
        rowSums(z[, prepared$grid$tc_id %in% ids & prepared$grid$Type == cell_grid$Type[i], drop = FALSE])
    }, numeric(nrow(z)))
    a <- sum_cells(pev)
    b <- sum_cells(regional)
    average <- function(z) vapply(rows$row_id, function(i) rowMeans(z[, cell_grid$row_id == i, drop = FALSE]), 
        numeric(nrow(z)))
    pa <- average(a)
    ra <- average(b)
    difference <- pa - ra
    describe <- function(z, prefix) {
        ans <- as.data.frame(t(apply(z, 2, function(x) c(mean = mean(x), median = median(x), lower = unname(quantile(x, 
            0.025)), upper = unname(quantile(x, 0.975))))))
        names(ans) <- paste0(prefix, names(ans))
        ans
    }
    numeric <- bind_cols(rows, describe(pa, "pev_"), describe(ra, "regional_"), describe(difference, 
        "difference_"))
    numeric$probability_pev_gt_regional <- colMeans(difference > 0)
    numeric$probability_pev_lt_regional <- colMeans(difference < 0)
    numeric$probability_difference_zero <- colMeans(difference == 0)
    numeric$draws_pev_gt_regional <- colSums(difference > 0)
    numeric$draws_pev_lt_regional <- colSums(difference < 0)
    numeric$support_note <- ifelse(rows$regional_full_survey_support, "", "Juvenile component not surveyed in the added broader Broward-Miami DRM surveys; regional estimate and comparison omitted.")
    diag_matrix <- cbind(pa[, rows$regional_full_survey_support, drop = FALSE], ra[, rows$regional_full_survey_support, 
        drop = FALSE], difference[, rows$regional_full_survey_support, drop = FALSE])
    labels <- paste(rows$taxon[rows$regional_full_survey_support], rows$class[rows$regional_full_survey_support], 
        sep = ":")
    colnames(diag_matrix) <- c(paste0(labels, ":PEV"), paste0(labels, ":regional"), paste0(labels, 
        ":difference"))
    ar <- array(diag_matrix, dim = c(dim(fit$draws)[1:2], ncol(diag_matrix)), dimnames = list(NULL, 
        NULL, colnames(diag_matrix)))
    diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(posterior::as_draws_array(ar), "mean", "mcse_mean", 
        "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")
    unavailable <- !rows$regional_full_survey_support
    for (n in c(paste0("regional_", c("mean", "median", "lower", "upper")), paste0("difference_", 
        c("mean", "median", "lower", "upper")), "probability_pev_gt_regional", "probability_pev_lt_regional", 
        "probability_difference_zero", "draws_pev_gt_regional", "draws_pev_lt_regional")) numeric[[n]][unavailable] <- NA
    fmt <- function(x, digits = 2) paste0(formatC(mean(x), format = "fg", digits = digits, flag = "#"), 
        " [", formatC(quantile(x, 0.025), format = "fg", digits = digits, flag = "#"), "–", formatC(quantile(x, 
            0.975), format = "fg", digits = digits, flag = "#"), "]")
    habitat_table <- pivot_wider(select(mutate(cell_grid, estimate = vapply(seq_len(ncol(a)), function(i) fmt(a[, 
        i]), character(1))), row_id, Type, estimate), names_from = Type, values_from = estimate)
    formatted <- select(mutate(left_join(select(rows, row_id, taxon, class), habitat_table, by = "row_id"), 
        PEV_habitat_averaged = vapply(seq_len(ncol(pa)), function(i) fmt(pa[, i], 3), character(1)), 
        Broward_Miami_habitat_averaged = vapply(seq_len(ncol(ra)), function(i) if (unavailable[i]) 
            ""
        else fmt(ra[, i], 3), character(1)), PEV_minus_Broward_Miami = vapply(seq_len(ncol(difference)), 
            function(i) if (unavailable[i]) 
                ""
            else fmt(difference[, i], 3), character(1)), Pr_PEV_gt_Broward_Miami = ifelse(unavailable, 
            "", sprintf("%.4f", numeric$probability_pev_gt_regional)), Pr_PEV_lt_Broward_Miami = ifelse(unavailable, 
            "", sprintf("%.4f", numeric$probability_pev_lt_regional)), regional_juvenile_full_DRM_support = rows$regional_full_survey_support, 
        support_note = numeric$support_note), -row_id)
    cell_summary <- bind_rows(mutate(bind_cols(cell_grid, describe(a, "")), region = "PEV"), mutate(bind_cols(cell_grid, 
        describe(b, "")), region = "Broward-Miami"))
    for (n in c("mean", "median", "lower", "upper")) cell_summary[[n]][cell_summary$region == "Broward-Miami" & 
        !cell_summary$regional_full_survey_support] <- NA
    averages <- bind_rows(mutate(rename_with(select(numeric, taxon, class, starts_with("pev_")), 
        ~sub("^pev_", "", .x), starts_with("pev_")), region = "PEV"), mutate(rename_with(select(select(numeric, 
        taxon, class, starts_with("regional_")), -regional_full_survey_support), ~sub("^regional_", 
        "", .x), starts_with("regional_")), region = "Broward-Miami"))
    adult <- prepared$grid$class == ">4cm"
    adult_row <- which(rows$taxon == "Total modeled taxa" & rows$class == ">4cm")
    mcav_all <- which(rows$taxon == "MCAV" & rows$class == "All")
    err_sum <- max(abs(pa[, adult_row] - rowSums(pev[, adult, drop = FALSE])/4), abs(ra[, adult_row] - 
        rowSums(regional[, adult, drop = FALSE])/4))
    err_diff <- max(abs(difference[, adult_row] - (rowSums(pev[, adult, drop = FALSE]) - rowSums(regional[, 
        adult, drop = FALSE]))/4))
    eligible <- which(rows$regional_full_survey_support)
    settings <- data.frame(dataset = "drm24", direction_effects = "zero", habitat_weighting = "Equal weights: NRC, IR, MR, OR", 
        posterior_draws = nrow(draw_matrix), adult_taxa = sum(prepared$tc$class == ">4cm"), surveyed_juvenile_groups = length(juvenile_groups), 
        reported_comparisons = length(eligible), probability_definition = "Fraction of paired draws with PEV minus Broward-Miami >0 or <0", 
        multiplicity_adjustment = "None; posterior summaries only", decision_rule = "None; no significance flags or posterior probability cutoff", 
        interval = "Pointwise equal-tailed 95% CrI", status = "Pilot posterior; comparisons provisional")
    validation <- data.frame(check = c("Adult sum preserves draw-wise covariance", "Adult total contrast equals direct sum of paired cell differences", 
        "Every adult taxon is compared", "Only surveyed juvenile groups compared", "MCAV All is compared", 
        "Unsupported regional values are blank", "Directional probabilities account for every posterior draw", 
        "Both probabilities equal paired posterior sign frequencies", "R predictions match independently computed Stan 2024 densities"), 
        pass = c(err_sum < 1e-12, err_diff < 1e-12, all(rows$regional_full_survey_support[rows$class == 
            ">4cm"]), all(rows$taxon[rows$class == "<4cm" & rows$regional_full_survey_support] %in% 
            c(juvenile_groups, "Surveyed juvenile groups (4)")), length(mcav_all) == 1 && rows$regional_full_survey_support[mcav_all], 
            all(formatted$Broward_Miami_habitat_averaged[unavailable] == "") && all(formatted$PEV_minus_Broward_Miami[unavailable] == 
                "") && all(formatted$Pr_PEV_gt_Broward_Miami[unavailable] == "") && all(formatted$Pr_PEV_lt_Broward_Miami[unavailable] == 
                ""), all(abs(numeric$probability_pev_gt_regional[eligible] + numeric$probability_pev_lt_regional[eligible] + 
                numeric$probability_difference_zero[eligible] - 1) < 1e-12), all(numeric$probability_pev_gt_regional[eligible] == 
                numeric$draws_pev_gt_regional[eligible]/nrow(draw_matrix)) && all(numeric$probability_pev_lt_regional[eligible] == 
                numeric$draws_pev_lt_regional[eligible]/nrow(draw_matrix)), stan_error < 1e-08))
    stopifnot(all(validation$pass), sum(rows$class == ">4cm" & rows$row_type == "Taxon") == 17L)
    write_csv(numeric, file.path(output_dir, "TableA3_regional_comparisons_numeric.csv"), na = "")
    legacy_contrast <- transmute(left_join(filter(numeric, row_type == "Taxon", class != "All"), 
        prepared$tc, by = c("taxon", "class")), taxon, class, tc_id, mean = difference_mean, median = difference_median, 
        lower = difference_lower, upper = difference_upper, probability_pev_gt_regional, probability_pev_lt_regional, 
        regional_full_survey_support)
    write_csv(legacy_contrast, file.path(output_dir, "habitat_averaged_2024_contrasts.csv"), na = "")
    evaluation_file <- file.path(output_dir, "evaluation.rds")
    if (file.exists(evaluation_file)) {
        evaluation <- readRDS(evaluation_file)
        evaluation$contrast <- legacy_contrast
        evaluation$regional_comparison_method <- settings
        saveRDS(evaluation, evaluation_file)
    }
    write_csv(formatted, file.path(output_dir, "TableA3_extended.csv"), na = "")
    write_csv(formatted, file.path(output_dir, "TableA3.csv"), na = "")
    write_csv(formatted[rows$row_type == "Taxon", c("taxon", "class", habitats)], file.path(output_dir, 
        "TableA3_PEV_habitats.csv"), na = "")
    write_csv(averages, file.path(output_dir, "TableA3_habitat_averages_numeric.csv"), na = "")
    write_csv(cell_summary, file.path(output_dir, "TableA3_regional_comparison_cells.csv"), na = "")
    write_csv(settings, file.path(output_dir, "TableA3_comparison_method.csv"))
    write_csv(diagnostics, file.path(output_dir, "TableA3_comparison_diagnostics.csv"))
    write_csv(validation, file.path(output_dir, "TableA3_comparison_validation.csv"))
    writeLines(c("Table A3. PEV and Broward-Miami coral densities predicted for DRM2024.", "Densities and PEV-minus-Broward-Miami differences are colonies/m2: posterior mean [pointwise 95% CrI].", 
        "Both regional means give each of NRC, IR, MR and OR weight 1/4 and set direction effects to zero.", 
        "All size classes, species sums and contrasts are calculated within each shared posterior draw before summarizing.", 
        "The adult total sums 17 modeled adult taxa. The full juvenile and All totals have no regional comparison.", 
        "Regional juvenile and All entries are blank where a juvenile component was not surveyed in the added broad DRM surveys.", 
        "Only MCAV, MEAN, MUSS and FAVI juveniles have complete added regional coverage; only MCAV has a survey-supported taxon-specific All row.", 
        "Surveyed juvenile groups (4) sums those four groups only, not the full juvenile community.", 
        "Pr_PEV_gt_Broward_Miami = Pr(PEV minus Broward-Miami >0 | data, model); Pr_PEV_lt_Broward_Miami = Pr(difference <0 | data, model).", 
        "Both columns report the observed fraction of paired posterior draws; they are not p-values and have no multiplicity adjustment.", 
        "No significance flags or posterior probability decision thresholds are applied. Intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous.", 
        sprintf("Probabilities are Monte Carlo estimates from %d pilot draws, displayed to four decimals (draw resolution %.4f).", 
            nrow(draw_matrix), 1/nrow(draw_matrix)), "A displayed 0.0000 or 1.0000 means no opposite-sign draw was observed, not certainty about the population difference.", 
        "The model fit and all reported comparisons remain provisional pending final sampling."), 
        file.path(output_dir, "TableA3_notes.txt"))
    manifest_file <- file.path(output_dir, "requested_outputs.csv")
    if (file.exists(manifest_file)) {
        manifest <- read_csv(manifest_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
        new_paths <- file.path(output_dir, c("TableA3.csv", "TableA3_extended.csv", "TableA3_PEV_habitats.csv", 
            "TableA3_regional_comparisons_numeric.csv", "TableA3_notes.txt"))
        manifest <- mutate(distinct(bind_rows(select(manifest, path), data.frame(path = new_paths)), 
            path), bytes = file.info(path)$size)
        write_csv(manifest, manifest_file)
    }
    list(numeric = numeric, formatted = formatted, cells = cell_summary, settings = settings, diagnostics = diagnostics, 
        validation = validation)
}


```

```{r regional-comparisons}
regional_comparison <- make_regional_table(prepared, joint_fit, output_dir)
regional_comparison$formatted %>%
  select(-regional_juvenile_full_DRM_support, -support_note) %>%
  show_table(digits = 4)
show_table(regional_comparison$validation)
```

Define \(\Delta=\text{PEV density}-\text{Broward–Miami density}\).
The probability columns are the observed fractions of posterior draws with
\(\Delta>0\) and \(\Delta<0\), conditional on the data and model. They are not
p-values and are not adjusted. No significance threshold or asterisks are
applied. The 95% credible intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous.
Probabilities displayed as 0.0000 or 1.0000 mean no opposite-sign draw was
observed; they do not establish certainty about the population difference.

The added broad DRM surveys comprehensively count only MCAV, MEAN, MUSS and
FAVI juveniles. Regional cells for other juveniles and their "All" rows are
blank, while valid PEV estimates remain visible. MCAV "All" is comparable.
The full juvenile and adult-plus-juvenile totals have no regional comparison;
the separately labeled four-group juvenile subtotal is not the whole juvenile
community. The adult total sums the 17 modeled adult taxa.

# Numerical results and reproducibility

```{r save-numerical-results}
write_csv(summary_equal_weighted_combined, output_file("survey_averaged_densities.csv"))
write_csv(summary_drm24_combined, output_file("PEV_2024_densities.csv"))
write_csv(trends_summary, output_file("temporal_trends.csv"))
write_csv(summary_datasets, output_file("temporal_source_densities.csv"))
write_csv(area_summary, output_file("habitat_areas_unrounded.csv"))
write_csv(tot3_intervals, output_file("Table2_intervals.csv"))
write_csv(tot3, output_file("Table2.csv"))
file.copy(output_file("intermediate/coral_Table1.csv"), output_file("Table1.csv"), overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(output_file("intermediate/coral_Fig1.png"), output_file("Fig1.png"), overwrite = TRUE)
file.copy(output_file("intermediate/coral_Fig1.pdf"), output_file("Fig1.pdf"), overwrite = TRUE)
saveRDS(list(survey = draws_equal_weighted, year2024 = draws_drm24_combined,
             trends = trends_combined, impact_survey = tot2_draws, impact_2024 = tot2_2024_draws),
        processed_file("manuscript_posterior_draws.rds"))
```

Table 2 uses `Total = ACER + ORBI + non-ESA` exactly once. The original
analysis's extra `adorn_totals(where = "col")` step double-counted an already
present Total column; that arithmetic error is corrected here. All habitat
areas are kept unrounded for colony-total calculations, while Table A1 retains
its original display rounding.

```{r final-validation}
required_outputs <- c(paste0("Fig", 1:6, ".png"), paste0("FigA", 1:6, ".png"),
                      paste0("Fig", 1:6, ".pdf"), paste0("FigA", 1:6, ".pdf"),
                      "Table1.csv", "Table2.csv", paste0("TableA", 1:6, ".csv"),
                      "TableA3_notes.txt", "TableA3_regional_comparisons_numeric.csv",
                      "survey_locations.png", "zonefig.png", "ACERORBI.png", "ACERORBI_2024.png")
output_inventory <- data.frame(output = required_outputs,
                               path = file.path(output_dir, required_outputs)) %>%
  mutate(exists = file.exists(path), bytes = file.info(path)$size)
write_csv(output_inventory, output_file("output_inventory.csv"))
current_checksums <- unname(tools::md5sum(original_checksums$path))
preservation <- original_checksums %>% mutate(current_md5 = current_checksums,
                                              unchanged = md5 == current_md5)
write_csv(preservation, output_file("original_files_preserved.csv"))
adult_total_check <- regional_comparison$numeric %>%
  filter(row_type == "Total", class == ">4cm")
final_validation <- data.frame(
  check = c("All original manuscript figure/table products generated",
            "Original analysis, original model, data and outputs unchanged",
            "Table 2 totals equal category sums",
            "Regional comparison predictions and paired sums validated",
            "The complete posterior is saved"),
  pass = c(all(output_inventory$exists & output_inventory$bytes > 0),
           all(preservation$unchanged),
           max(abs(tot3_intervals$Total - tot3_intervals$ACER - tot3_intervals$ORBI - tot3_intervals$`non-ESA`)) < 1e-6,
           all(regional_comparison$validation$pass), file.exists(fit_file))
)
write_csv(final_validation, output_file("final_validation.csv"))
stopifnot(all(final_validation$pass))
show_table(final_validation)
show_table(output_inventory %>% select(output, exists, bytes), digits = 0)
fit_status("complete")
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), output_file("sessionInfo.txt"))
```

To render from the project root:

```{r render-instructions, eval=FALSE}
rmarkdown::render(
  "analysis/coral_joint_analysis/coral_joint_analysis.Rmd",
  output_dir = "outputs/coral_joint_analysis",
  knit_root_dir = getwd()
)
```

For a longer manuscript fit, change `warmup`, `sampling` and any sampler
controls in the YAML parameters, set `allow_new_fit: true`, and optionally
choose another `output_directory`. Matching cached fits are always reused.
The posterior is saved immediately on sampling completion, before any
downstream figure or report can fail.
